methods.description: The sign-in methods on offer, in order (the last one used first is the app's to remember).

signups.description: An attack switch: new accounts with a password, or any new accounts, paused for now.

sentryDsn.description: The browser error reporter's Sentry DSN (public by design): its envelopes go to /log/errors, which scrubs and forwards them. Null when it isn't set up, and the app sends nothing.

turnstileSiteKey.description: Set while shield mode is on: show Cloudflare Turnstile on sign-up, sign-in and reset, and send its token as turnstileToken.

comingSoon.description: Before launch, and this visitor isn't let in yet (no beta pass, not signed in): show only signing in, the emails' token pages and the invite pages. Never cached (no-store).

prelaunch.description: Before launch (coming soon is on), whoever is asking; comingSoon is false for anyone let in.

instrumentsIndexUrl.description: The real-instrument samples' index (instruments/index.json on the media CDN): each instrument's current version and its manifest. Null where instruments are off: the apps use the synth.

selfHosted.description: A self-hosted install (SELF_HOSTED on its server): every account has Plus, so the app shows no Plus page link, Get Plus button or See Plus, and says Plus is included. False on stackapella.com.

usageCounts.description: Whether the app sends its anonymous usage counts (counts.create). False on a self-hosted install unless its owner turns them on.

coachSignup.description: Coaches can apply (the coach_signup switch); the directory that lists them is a separate switch.

enrol.description: A new device draws an arm at its first open (f_arrive) only while true (from the experiment's start until its end day); devices already in an arm keep sending it.

experiment.description: The funnel's running A/B experiment (admin.funnel.show), or null when none runs or usage counts are off. A device sends "<id>-<arm>" as counts.create's variant.
